newsitem.title: USA: Bank of NY to buy Wells Fargo unit.
newsitem.headline: Bank of NY to buy Wells Fargo unit.

text.p: Bank of New York Co Inc said on Wednesday that it and its affiliate, BNY Western Trust Co, have signed a definitive agreement to acquire the Corporate and Municipal Bond Administration business of Wells Fargo & Co.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
Bank of New York said it expects the transaction to be completed during the first quarter of 1997 and add to earnings immediately.

The acquisition involves the transfer of about 5,000 bond trustee and agency appointments representing more than $85 billion in outstanding securities for municipal and corporate issuers primarily in the western United States.
Client services will be provided through BNY Western Trust Company, headquartered in Los Angeles, the company said.
